verdict.rationale: Postmark's own API documents several batch endpoints: `/email/batch` and `/email/batchWithTemplates` for multi-message sends, and `/email/bulk` for broadcast streams. There is also a TypeScript batch example with per-recipient MessageID and error reporting, plus the ability to push templates to another server. Missing for 10: bulk operations beyond sending (e.g., bulk bounce reactivation or bulk message actions), documented batch size limits and semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration of batch behavior.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
